CAIRO MUSEUM
Each place of interest to you in this great museum costs one 
hour to visit: 
• For Treasures from the Pyramids, go to 290.
• For Tombs of the Ancients, go to 236.
• For the Karpathos Device, go to 247. 
• If you want to interview Amet Keh, the Curator, go to 314. 
When finished here, go to any Cairo location on the Egypt 
Location Table.
(Egypt Location)
